notes.title: Drift Scoring System (DSS)
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Driftheads![/h1]

[b]For Today.[/b] Work is in progress, game is testing and improving.

[b]About Interesting.[/b] We are making a game with championships with new score systems.

[b]In the end of 2015,[/b] game was based on browser platform, there was an idea to make Global drift championship. In 2016 we start to test new score system, we called it Drift Scoring System (DSS).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/5a947cb64c0e4ee81a325397c8f845683ce308c4.png[/img]
All worked fine, but were faced the problems:
[list]
[*]Bad game physics
[*]Not enough drift tracks
[*]etc.
[/list]

[b]Game Physics.[/b]
We went to the core and rebuilt it. We made physics more dynamic with more deeper interactions, more reliable and more realistic. "Fun to play, hard to master". We will hope that you will like it! It will be fun, but difficult enough.

[b]Not enough tracks.[/b]
Our current tracks completely didn’t fit the new standards of the game (physics and championships).
We decided to look at Formula Drift. Dynamic track configurations, complex terrain, bankings, concrete blocks. It looks very cool, and I hope it will also look cool in the game, because now these tracks are in game.


[b]It was a short prehistory. [/b] Now about [i]DSS[/i].

Glossary of terms:
[list]
[*][b]DSS[/b] ([i]Drift Scoring System[/i]) - The system for calculating scores on track in the Drift discipline.
[*][b]Preinitiation[/b] - Zone before the first sector, in which the scores are not counted. At the end of this zone the car must be in drift.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/da15c0b71cbc49434bb4d189dd9c1e1d8673bad4.png[/img]
[*][b]Line (or Trajectory)[/b] - The line way determined by the judicial task.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/99215385724bd18e292289dcb49436b9933344bd.png[/img]
[*][b]Speed[/b] - Vector physical quantity, characterizing the speed of movement and the direction of movement of the car on track.
[*][b]Angle[/b] - The value of degrees on which the car deviates relative to the velocity vector.
[*][b]Correction[/b] - The deviation from any parameter, determined by the referee's assignment, is for the worse.
[*][b]Clipping point[/b] (Clipper) - Landmark on the track, defined by the referee's task. They are divided into internal and external. To the internal you need to be close to the front bumper, to the external - the rear bumper.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/c46ad2b3b5f02012e9ee5624cc727bb676e9c38e.png[/img]
[*][b]Qualification[/b] - Qualifying single races, passing by the referee's task.
[*][b]Twin arrival[/b] - Arrival of two pilots, passing by the judge's task. Lead pilot - Leader. Chasing pilot - Chaser.
[*][b]Leader[/b] - The pilot who is driving the train. Goes ahead on the assignment of qualification.
[*][b]Chaser[/b] -  The pilot who adjusts for the arrival of the leader. Rides behind the leader, repeating his line.
[*][b]Distance to leader[/b] - Distance between the chasing car and the leader.
[/list]

[b]DSS. How it works?[/b]

DSS takes several basic parameters, of which the drift consists - speed, angle, trajectory, preinitiation, car setting and distance to the leader. Everything adds up and produces the final result. It's simple!

Each track is divided into a sector. Each sector has its own maximum score. The value is given by a percentage based on 100 points. This will be separately stipulated in the judge's task.

 In each sector there are clipping points, to which you need to be as close as possible, at the maximum possible angle and at the maximum possible speed. he main thing is not to overdo it, because for get off the track you automatically will get 0 points for the sector. 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/bc2d5ad48a36f531963af2736a3730dd757725a0.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495689/7671fabc27ef94d7e2d8ecc7fe93c05c3aac7e89.png[/img]
Also, remember the trajectory that you must follow. You need to go smoothly, without correction, otherwise DSS punishes you. Even if you are ideally past the clipping point.  

There are some limitations on the track - cones that can not be knocked down. For the downed cone DSS prescribes 0 points for the whole race. (It is believed that you are trying to escape from the opponent, cutting the way.) And accordingly, the boundaries of the track - yellow markings, for which you can’t call in. 

In the pair races for the Chaser, the Leader arrives for the landmark. That is, the task of the Chaser is to repeat the leader, not allowing his mistakes.

[b]Summary[/b]
Perform a judicial task!

Thanks for your time.

Your [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/hodcom/]Apro[/url].

Many thanks to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/k4waii] CFW [/url] for his help in translating!

notes.title: European server 2HR technical break
notes.content:
Hey, what's up, driftheads?

First of all, we need to do some techincal stuff on european server for next couple of hours. It will be down from 06:00 GMT till ~ 08:00 GMT, if I read it correctly.

Next thing. We're alive and working non-stop on a new update with new physics, improved graphics, better optimization and new content. It's almost a brand new game :D. Sorry for keeping low profile, just too many things to carry on. We're hoping to improve it with making new admins from player base, which will update you on current state of development. I will make a new post with details on stuff we're working on with some gifs and images and blackjack and stuff.

Did you know you can already check first public beta of new client? You need to switch to beta in game preferences via steam: RIght mouse button on High Octane Drift in Steam Game Library -> Preferences -> Betas -> choose "test". It's a bit rough on a controllers, but we've already fixed it in internal beta builds. Soon we will release a series of betas, where we will update car or pack of cars with new models and new set up for updated physics.

Thanks again for all your support and comments. It's gonna be huge! :D
Cheers! 
- Iliya

notes.title: v0.3.1 and roadmap
notes.content:
Hey, driftheads!

v0.3.1 brings new sponsor for levels 1 to 45. Easy greens, check it out. Full changelog is in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/457330/discussions/0/224446432327696828/]its thread[/url].

We haven't heard of a crashing bug for some time already. People say it's working now. Nicely done! :D

As far as general issues seem to be fixed, moving further. 
[list]
[*] We heard you about pretty tight f2p system, with not so many opportunities to get cash. Starting to add new sponsors already with pretty generous prizes. Also, we're gonna introduce a new type of events, work name "Marcus challenges", where you will be awarded different custom stuff for your car, like suspension, gearbox and so on. Working to add more greens to the economy.
[*] Car models are in the process of changing their bodies to look more like real-world prototypes. Also, we're thinking of ways how steam workshop will operate. At the moment, we have curated workshop and we can sell cars directly for real-world money, giving authors a share. Would like to hear your opinion on this.
[*] Vehicle dynamics is going to be changed a lot. We've refactored almost every aspect, body rolls and accelerations, gearbox, aerodynamics, new tire model and much more. This should solve all current "physics issues".  More updates on dynamics update later.
[*] Engine sounds are going to be replaced. We're trying a different approach on sound engine, should be a relief for ears.
[*] We've got some new tracks already which we need to polish a bit, check performance and publish it. 
[*] Teams and Drifting Series are on their way, more detailed update on each later.
[/list]

Sorry for communication lag, lots of stuff to be done. Thank you for your support and keep drifting fun!

notes.title: Day3 fixes, x86 and REPORT THAT CRASH
notes.content:
Hi,

Firstly, we would like to ask to submit your bug and crash reports. We can't reproduce most of your connection and crashing issues. If you do experience something of it, please submit us a crash report. You can read more in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/457330/discussions/0/348293230314431704/]steam sticky post[/url], which will eventually lead you to our forum [url=http://cruderocks.com/?view=thread&id=24]post[/url]. Most detailed crash or severe bug reports will be awarded.

Secondly, in this brief fix we've addressed following issues:
[list]
[*] [b]Keyboard is not responding[/b] issue was addressed. We've made an additional check for logitech wrapping library which was causing the issue. We've given the fixed client for a test to some players, they said the issue is resolved. If it is not resolved for you, then submit a bug report (same way as a crash report)
[*] [b]Purchasing[/b] of cars and parts should be fixed. If you still experience some problems with that, please submit a bug report.
[*] Race results should be fixed and not stay there forever.
[*] Camera's view cycle should be fixed
[*] Self-repair button is in order now
[/list]

Thirdly, what issues are being addressed and may occur:
[list]
[*] [b]Spontaneous crashes[/b]. They are very system specific, please submit a crash log.
[*] [b]Disconnected from lobby[/b]. This state means that either:
[b]a. your firewall/antiviral is blocking traffic to our server (try to disable them for a while or add to exceptions)[/b];
b. your Microsoft Visual C++ is not installed correctly ([url=https://www.microsoft.com/ru-ru/download/details.aspx?id=48145]download[/url]);
c. your network address might be blocked by hosting firewall;
d. there was some kind of internal error.
In any case, please submit a bug report.
[*] Interface issues
[*] 180x UVs have a strange offset. Going to update model on oct. 18.
[/list]

And finally, we've uploaded an x86 version, which should be available to downloads.

notes.title: Early Access Release Notes
notes.content:
Hey, driftheads! What up?)

It's been a long way to Steam release, but here it is. Early Access version b0.2.3. Only US server, as we've mentioned before. But EU server is coming right away.

We are expecting minor bugs, which could be annoying but shouldn't be critical. Please, report them through Steam Discussion or on our forum @ cruderocks.com

UPD: people already reporting keyboard not interacting >_<.  If you are using any kind of antiviral with sandbox mode, try shut it down for a while. We will investigate into it ASAP.

Some things might be a bit frustrating without proper helping tips, we're working on it. If that's the case don't hesitate to ask. There is a community of players migrating from different social networks, who can actually help with an advice.

Account transfer from Facebook to Steam will be covered in a different announcement.

Content is a bit rough in some places because we drag it since web-client prototype, but we're already putting effort to replace it and polish some new before going public.

Supposedly, next week we're going to open Workshop where you can upload custom car models straight to the game and send it to a curated High Octane Drift Steam Workshop. In case your model will actually make to the game, you will be paid royalties by Steam. We are pretty excited what opportunities it will bring. but more on that later.

Drift On!

tags.bug: - UPD: people already reporting keyboard not interacting >_<.

Content is a bit rough in some places because we drag it since web-client prototype, but we're already putting effort to replace it and polish some new before going public.

Supposedly, next week we're going to open Workshop where you can upload custom car models straight to the game and send it to a curated High Octane Drift Steam Workshop. In case your model will actually make to the game, you will be paid royalties by Steam. We are pretty excited what opportunities it will bring. but more on that later.

Drift On!
